minutes: median planner-style duration (first boarding to arrival) over a query at every minute of the window; paid limited expresses excluded; station complexes as endpoints, no walk

out_min.u16.description: Outbound median minutes, origin station -> candidate

out_xfer.u8.description: Outbound transfers of the representative journey

out_routes.u16.description: Outbound routes, one block per candidate (see out_routes_idx.u32), one route per origin station in index order: [hop count, then per hop: railway | flags, boarding station only if flags has 0x4000 (walk from the previous hop's end), station where the hop ends]. 0x8000 = seated through-running, no change of train

out_routes_idx.u32.description: Start of each candidate's block in out_routes.u16

home_min.u16.description: Home median minutes, candidate -> home station

home_xfer.u8.description: Home transfers of the representative journey

home_routes.u16.description: Home routes, one block per candidate (see home_routes_idx.u32), one route per home station in index order, same encoding as out_routes.u16

home_routes_idx.u32.description: Start of each candidate's block in home_routes.u16

last_dep.u16.description: Latest departure from the candidate that still reaches the home station, minutes after 00:00 of the service day (may exceed 1440)
